comment: CISG is a ratified treaty with a Fedlex abbreviation (SR 0.221.211.1, the decision itself calls it Swiss federal law), so the four CISG citations are STATUTE, not OTHER_LAW. BGB citations stay OTHER_LAW. Outcome: item 1 rules on the subsidiary constitutional complaint (nicht eingetreten), item 2 dismisses the civil appeal; two appeals with different results, took the first per guideline.
